jobs.occupation: Dangerous Goods Expert (all genders) (full-time / part-time) (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.Your role:In this pivotal role, you will shape the future of safe and compliant product transport across a broad global life science portfolio, driving regulatory excellence at scale. You will assess dangerous goods classifications, determine packaging requirements and transport restrictions, and develop compliant solutions in close collaboration with cross functional teams. Beyond day-to-day advisory work, you will lead the continuous improvement, streamlining, and automation of global dangerous goods processes, combining deep technical expertise with a forward-looking mindset to increase both compliance and operational efficiency. Whether working within a team  or steering dedicated projects, you will act as a trusted expert and mentor, influencing technical direction and contributing to the strategic development of the function.This position is limited to 2 years.Who you are:- You hold a minimum master’s degree in chemistry or a related field.- You have a sound knowledge of dangerous goods transport and professional expertise in DG classification (DOT, RID/ADR, IATA, IMO, PK1 certification) as well as DG Safety Advisor training.- You have proven experience with SAP EHSM and common analytic tools.- You have proven experience in programming (e.g. Python, JAVA, KNIME).- You have strong project management and communication skills.- You have excellent German and English skills - C Level.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Project Engineer (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.description: VetterTec is an innovative company headquartered in Kassel, Germany, with more than 95 years of experience in the development and manufacturing of machinery and systems for industrial drying and dewatering, particularly for the food processing industry. With a team of more than 160 employees across six locations and an international sales share exceeding 80%, we offer an exciting and dynamic working environment.To support our continued growth, we are looking for a Project Engineer who is passionate about driving technically demanding projects to success.As a Project Engineer, you take ownership of projects from kick-off through final handover, both technically and organizationally. Acting as the customer's main point of contact, you work closely with Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, and site teams to ensure successful project execution. This role is ideal for someone who leads through technical expertise and practical experience, with a strong focus on technical project responsibility rather than pure project coordination.Your Responsibilities:- Full project ownership from order handover to technical and commercial handover (TOC) - budget, schedule, risk and scope- Single point of contact for the customer throughout the project- Functional leadership of the core project team - holding the team's capacity together and keeping the project moving as one- Technical judgment: understanding the equipment and the process well enough to challenge assumptions and demand the right decisions at the right time- On-site presence at the milestones that matter — project kick-off, construction start, mechanical and electrical completion, commissioning start, and the final performance run (Leistungsfahrt) through handover- Presence at key suppliers for the acceptance (FAT) of critical components- Running the team's agile rhythm - weekly syncs, a shared task board, rolling short-term planning, and visualizing progress - and adjusting quickly when the project needs it- Integrating the contributions of Technical Engineering, Process Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, Installation and Commissioning into one coherent project, without replacing any of themWhat You Bring:- Professional experience in international plant or equipment engineering (Anlagenbau), ideally with process or industrial equipment- A hands-on, practical mindset — someone who has stood on a shop floor or a construction site, not only in front of a screen; we weigh practical experience over theoretical credentials- A mechanical engineering background as a Techniker (completed apprenticeship plus Techniker) or a comparable practical qualification (Bachelor's / FH degree)- Experience in vessel and plant construction (Anlagen- und Behälterbau) - manufacturing methods and welding processes- Project management capability - comfortable owning budget, schedule and risk - with a technical center of gravity- Business-fluent English (must-have); German is a plus, not a requirement- Willingness to travel internationally, including assignments of around two weeks at a time- Comfortable leading a team with lightweight agile practices - task boards, short review cycles, rolling planning - rather than heavyweight process- Professional or Senior level - we are hiring at bothHow We Work:- Projects follow a clear phase structure, but day to day we work in short cycles — weekly team syncs, a shared task board, and rolling four-to-six-week planning alongside the overall schedule- Remote work is possible for this role, with on-site presence expected for supplier acceptances of key components and for construction and site activities- You don't need to be based in Germany- Onboarding starts in the office; afterwards, your working pattern is by arrangement- A relaxed, direct working atmosphere — we'd rather solve a problem in the team meeting than escalate itWhat We Offer:- Real ownership of international projects from kick-off through commissioning and final handover- A technically challenging role with a high level of responsibility and the opportunity to shape Project Engineering at VetterTec- A collaborative, solution-oriented culture with short decision-making processes- 30 days of annual leave, attractive working conditions, and a competitive compensation package- Comprehensive employee benefits, including bike leasing, subsidized public transportation, Corporate Benefits, and additional company benefits- Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an international environment﻿Please don't spend time writing a cover letter. Instead, send us a brief project portfolio describing a project you have taken from the initial phase through execution and final handover, highlighting your responsibilities, key challenges, and achieved results.**Take Your Opportunity - **Join us and actively contribute to the continued growth and development of our company. Together, we strive to inspire our employees and customers through innovative technology, modern structures, and sustainable growthTogether Towards the Future. Are You Ready to Join Us?If you have any questions regarding this position, please contact Ms. Jasmin Hohmann at +49 561 50019-201.Convince Us. We Look Forward to Getting to Know You!Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Projektmanagement, Anlagenbau, Fertigungstechnik, Schweißtechnik

jobs.occupation: Global Salesforce Business Analyst & Admin (m/f/d) – Customer Service & Platform (Business-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Introduction/About usAs Global Salesforce Business Analyst & Admin (m/f/d) - Customer Service & Platform, you are responsible for analyzing, shaping, documenting, and supporting the implementation of business requirements for the Customer Service and Platform stream within the global Customer Engagement ecosystem (Salesforce CRM), with a strong focus on Salesforce Service Cloud and Platform capabilities.You act as the key interface between Customer Service stakeholders, Product Owners, technical teams, and regional or local CRM specialists. The role combines strong Business Analysis capabilities with hands-on Salesforce configuration knowledge. You translate business needs into clear, testable user stories and solution concepts and can independently implement approved no-code and low-code changes within the applicable governance framework.Your focus is on scalable, harmonized, and user-centered Customer Service and Platform solutions. You ensure that global processes can be adopted effectively across regions while enabling appropriate localization for market-specific operational and regulatory requirements. You contribute functional and technical expertise across case management, customer interactions, knowledge, entitlements, service channels, automation, data quality, reporting, and related integrations.Your responsibilitiesBusiness Analysis and Requirements Engineering- Plan, facilitate, and document workshops, interviews, process mapping, and refinement sessions with global and local Customer Service stakeholders; analyze processes, pain points, objectives, user needs, dependencies, risks, and business value.- Translate business needs into complete, consistent, testable, and traceable epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, data, and non-functional requirements aligned with platform strategy and scope.- Challenge demands and identify opportunities to standardize, simplify, reuse, automate, or leverage existing Salesforce capabilities.- Maintain and prioritize the backlog with the Product Owner based on value, urgency, risk, effort, dependencies, and strategic alignment; document requirements and decisions in JIRA and Confluence.Functional Solution Design and Salesforce Configuration:- Design maintainable Service Cloud and Platform solutions with Product Owners, architects, developers, integration specialists, data teams, and other platform streams, assessing standard functionality, configuration, low-code automation, integration, or custom development.- Configure approved no-code and low-code changes within governance and deployment processes, including objects and fields, layouts, Dynamic Forms, record types, Lightning pages, list views, queues, assignment and validation rules, reports, dashboards, Flow automation, and other declarative capabilities.- Create prototypes or proof-of-concept configurations and assess end-to-end impacts on processes, data, integrations, automation, reporting, permissions, mobile use, and dependent platform streams.- Ensure compliance with architecture, security, access-control, data protection, naming, documentation, and release standards; collaborate with developers for Apex, Lightning Web Components, or other coded solutions, as software development is outside the role.Customer Service Process and Platform Ownership Support- Serve as functional expert for Customer Service processes and Service Cloud, including case lifecycle, inquiries, interaction history, routing and queues, service channels, knowledge, entitlements and milestones, templates, automation, and reporting.- Drive consistent end-to-end processes and data flows across Customer Service, Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, and connected systems; evolve reusable global templates while enabling justified, controlled localization.- Identify improvements to agent productivity, first-contact resolution, response quality, process transparency, and customer experience.- Support the responsible evaluation and adoption of AI-enabled and automation capabilities, including Agentforce where applicable.Testing, Release, and Deployment Support- Define test scenarios and expected results; prepare and execute functional testing and support integration, end-to-end, regression, and user acceptance testing.- Triage defects, clarify expected behavior, support root-cause analysis, and coordinate resolution with the appropriate teams.- Support release planning, readiness, deployment preparation, release notes, post-deployment validation, and hypercare; help prioritize incidents, defects, process gaps, and enhancements.Stakeholder Collaboration and Enablement- Build trusted relationships with global and local Customer Service stakeholders; communicate effectively with business and technical audiences and facilitate decisions by clearly presenting options, trade-offs, impacts, recommendations, and open points.- Guide local CRM specialists on market adoption, training, end-user support, and complex or escalated topics.- Create or support process documentation, user guidance, release communications, training materials, and enablement concepts.- Contribute to cross-regional communities of practice and promote consistent Business Analysis and Salesforce configuration standards.Data, Reporting, and Operational Support- Ensure the quality, consistency, integrity, and appropriate use of Customer Service and cross-stream Platform data, including cases, interactions, accounts, contacts, knowledge, entitlements, and service history.- Define reporting requirements and create or support reports and dashboards for operational management, service performance, adoption tracking, and continuous improvement.- Analyze incidents, user feedback, process performance, and platform usage to identify improvements; provide expert functional support for complex or escalated topics and coordinate with technical teams as needed.Your qualifications- Degree in business administration, economics, IT, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.- At least 5 years in Business Analysis, CRM, Customer Service, commercial operations, or a related field—preferably Pharma/Life Sciences—including 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce Service Cloud experience in a BA, Functional Consultant, Administrator, or similar role.- Expertise in requirements elicitation, process analysis, workshops, user stories, acceptance criteria, backlog refinement, stakeholder alignment, agile delivery, JIRA, and Confluence.- Hands-on Salesforce declarative and low-code configuration, including Flow; able to implement governed code-free changes and assess automation, errors, maintainability, and testing.- Strong Service Cloud knowledge: case management, routing/queues, channels, knowledge, entitlements, automation, security, data models, reporting, and integrations.- Experience in functional testing, UAT, defect triage, releases, and hypercare; knowledge of role-based access, profiles/permission sets, data protection, auditability, and controlled deployments.- Salesforce Business Analyst certification required or obtainable within an agreed period; Administrator and Service Cloud Consultant certifications strongly preferred.- Strong analytical, conceptual, problem-solving, facilitation, documentation, stakeholder-management, and communication skills; able to balance value, user experience, standardization, risk, and maintainability.- Structured, independent, collaborative, results- and detail-oriented; accountable, interculturally competent, fluent in English, additional languages advantageous, and willing to travel internationally at least 30% as required.What we offerJoin #futurefresenius and drive the future of MedTech Quality with us. Make an impact in a strategic role that shapes organizational excellence in medical technology.ContactApply now through our online portal to submit your application and join our team.

You will help Quality strengthen regulatory expertise, leadership and culture, bringing an independent point of view on how expertise-driven organizations should be built and the credibility to advocate it at executive level. Reporting directly to the Vice President Global HR MedTech, you will be a key member of the MedTech HR Leadership Team and help define the standards and ways of working for dedicated global HR business partnering across MedTech.Possible work locations: Germany, Poland, France, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands, and the UKYour responsibilities- Lead organizational design and organizational development for Quality, shaping how the function is structured, where expertise is located and how its leadership is composed.- Advise and constructively challenge the EVP Global Quality and their leadership team on organizational, talent and leadership priorities, bringing an independent and evidence-based perspective.- Translate capability gaps into coordinated build, buy, borrow and redeploy strategies in collaboration with business leaders and the HR Centres of Expertise.- Develop leaders who combine technical depth with people leadership and strengthen the culture that underpins sustained quality performance.- Convert global organizational decisions into executable plans, accounting for local employment law, consultation requirements and market practice across the countries in which Quality operates.- Partner with local HR organizations, the central MedTech HR team and the Centres of Expertise to deploy group-wide programmes in a way that fits Quality and feeds the function's requirements back into their design.- Apply people analytics, organizational insight and external market perspectives to inform executive decision-making.- Contribute to global transformation initiatives beyond Quality as a member of the MedTech HR Leadership Team and support the development of HR capability across MedTech.Your qualifications- Proven expertise in Organizational Design and Organizational Development, with a track record of designing organizations that enable business strategy, quality and future growth.- Significant experience partnering with executive leaders in global organizations, ideally as a Global HR Business Partner, with a proven ability to advise, influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders.- Experience leading large-scale organizational transformation initiatives, including organizational redesign, operating model evolution, capability building and change management in complex stakeholder environments.- Strong analytical, conceptual and systems-thinking capabilities, combined with the business acumen to translate strategic priorities into pragmatic organizational solutions and executable future-state visions.- Excellent communication, facilitation and executive presentation skills, with fluent English; additional language skills are an advantage.- Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Organizational Development or a related field.- Experience supporting global Quality, Regulatory or other highly regulated functions, ideally within MedTech or Healthcare.- Experience establishing or further developing HR business partnering models, as well as Leadership Development, Talent Management and Capability Building initiatives.- Experience partnering with external consulting firms to develop and implement strategic organizational solutions.- Extensive executive and leadership coaching experience; a formal coaching certification is an advantage.What we offerJoin #futurefresenius and drive the future of MedTech Quality with us. Make an impact in a strategic role that shapes organizational excellence in medical technology.ContactApply now through our online portal to submit your application and join our team.

jobs.occupation: Managing Consultant Global IT Vendor Management (m/f/d) (Global-Sourcing-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Introduction/About usGroup IT Strategy, Sourcing & Transformation shapes and supports the execution of the One IT vision across Fresenius. The department brings together IT procurement, strategic sourcing, vendor management, enterprise architecture, IT governance and service management to strengthen collaboration, ensure compliance and harmonize IT processes across the Group.We are looking for an experienced Managing Consultant for Global IT Vendor Management (m/f/d) to lead the strategy, governance, commercial performance and executive relationships for selected strategic IT vendors. In this role, you will help protect contractual value, improve supplier performance, coordinate commercial and third-party risks, and ensure that strategic vendor relationships deliver measurable and sustainable business outcomes.Your responsibilities- Vendor strategy: Develop and maintain short- and long-term strategies for assigned strategic IT vendors, with measurable objectives covering cost optimization, service performance, technology adoption, innovation, contractual protection, flexibility and overall value.- Contract lifecycle: Coordinate contractual obligations, commercial milestones, amendments, change orders, renewals, termination planning and exit readiness. Maintain a forward-looking renewal pipeline and ensure that contractual decisions receive the approvals and signatures required under applicable company policies.- Commercial governance: Monitor spend, consumption, commitments, pricing mechanisms, indexation, credits, penalties, caps, thresholds and other contractual levers. Identify potential commercial leakage and optimization opportunities and coordinate approved actions with Finance, Procurement, product owners and vendors.- Vendor performance: Establish and operate vendor scorecards covering service, commercial, financial, risk, innovation and stakeholder dimensions. Validate performance information, identify root causes and trends, and coordinate corrective and continuous-improvement plans.- Governance: Design and facilitate strategic, tactical and operational governance forums with appropriate participants, decision rights, escalation paths, agendas, cadence and documented actions. Lead executive Quarterly Business Reviews and track agreed commitments through to closure.- Sourcing and negotiations: Partner with Strategic Sourcing, Procurement, Legal and other relevant functions on sourcing events, renewals and complex negotiations. Conduct market analysis, benchmarking and commercial scenario modelling and prepare decision-ready business cases for the applicable approval bodies.- Third-party risk: Maintain a consolidated view of vendor-related risks and coordinate assessments, reporting and remediation with accountable functions such as Information Security, Data Protection, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Procurement and Business Continuity. Escalate material risks through the applicable governance channels.- Stakeholder relationships: Act as a primary commercial and governance interface between assigned strategic vendors and internal stakeholders. Facilitate cross-functional decisions, manage escalations and translate complex commercial, performance and risk matters into clear recommendations.Your qualifications- Substantial relevant experience in strategic IT vendor management, technology sourcing, contract and commercial management, procurement or a comparable supplier-governance role in a complex international organization.- Demonstrated experience managing complex and strategically important IT contracts or vendor portfolios, including commercial governance, service levels, contractual obligations, renewals, disputes and exit provisions.- Strong commercial and contractual expertise, including negotiation, benchmarking, business-case development, cost optimization and the application of contractual value levers.- Experience establishing and operating vendor-performance and governance frameworks, including scorecards, KPIs, SLAs, executive reviews, improvement plans and escalation processes.- A sound understanding of third-party risk management, including supplier due diligence, information security, data protection, compliance, financial risk and operational resilience.- Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a matrix organization, influence senior internal and supplier stakeholders, resolve complex escalations and facilitate decisions without relying on direct authority.- Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to interpret commercial, financial, performance and risk information and present clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.- Business-fluent English, required for global stakeholder and vendor engagement. German language skills are an advantage for collaborating with stakeholders based in Germany.What we offerShape strategic technology partnerships that deliver measurable value, resilient services and controlled risk across Fresenius — join #futurefresenius and make an impact!ContactApply now through our online portal to submit your application.
